page_title: MAR 3-0 LYO | Marseille v Lyon 06/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Chancel Mbemba (Marseille) was too forceful with his tackle and Francois Letexier interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' POST! Bilal Nadir (Marseille) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was!
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mahamadou Diawara (Lyon) was quite harsh and Francois Letexier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
84' A cross from Pape Gueye (Marseille) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
84' Substitution. Azzedine Ounahi did his best and is replaced by Pape Gueye (Marseille).
84' Substitution. Bilal Nadir (Marseille) replaces Vitinha.
83' Marseille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
82' Pierre Sage has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tino Kadewere (Lyon) replacing Rayan Cherki.
82' Pierre Sage prepares a substitution. Dejan Lovren is replaced by Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon).
80' Renan Lodi doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
79' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Dejan Lovren (Lyon) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
78' Lyon quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
78' Clinton Mata (Lyon) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. It will be a corner kick for Lyon.
78' Lyon have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
77' Vitinha (Marseille) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom left corner only for Anthony Lopes to dive and make a save.
76' Clinton Mata (Lyon) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Marseille have a free kick.
74' Renan Lodi (Marseille) commits a rough challenge and Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul.
72' A substitution has been made. Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang goes off and Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) comes on.
70' Pierre Sage has decided to make a change. Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) replaces Diego Moreira.
69' The manager makes a subsitution with Jeffinho (Lyon) coming on for Ernest Nuamah.
68' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Marseille due to a handball in the build-up play.
68' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible handball. The Marseille players aren’t happy.
67' Goal! Vitinha (Marseille) scores after an assist by Samuel Gigot that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 4:0.
66' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Marseille comes to nothing.
65' The resulting set piece from Marseille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
62' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
61' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
59' Francois Letexier has a clear sight and sees a foul from Renan Lodi (Marseille).

55' 3 - 0 Goal Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille)! Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) was put through by Vitinha and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the right side of the net. 3:0.
54' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mahamadou Diawara (Lyon) will replace Paul Akouokou.
52' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) gets past Anthony Lopes in goal, but is driven too wide and the angle is just too tough to find the net.
51' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
49' The main referee, Francois Letexier, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) is given a yellow card for dissent.
49' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
47' Flag goes up against Vitinha (Marseille) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
47' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the right post.
46' Referee Francois Letexier blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Lyon fail to score from a corner as Pau Lopez (Marseille) leaps to collect the ball.
45+2' Diego Moreira (Lyon) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
45+1' Renan Lodi (Marseille) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Jake O'Brien (Lyon) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Francois Letexier saw the whole situation. Marseille win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
43' The referee blows his whistle after Jordan Veretout (Marseille) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
42' Anthony Lopes (Lyon) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
41' The game is interrupted now, Anthony Lopes (Lyon) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
40' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
40' Marseille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
38' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
36' The corner is swung in but Marseille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

36' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Anthony Lopes leaps like a salmon to deny him. The referee points to the corner flag and Marseille will take a corner.
34' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.
31' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
27' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:1.

25' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Michael Murillo (Marseille) makes it 2:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang and planted his close-range header into the right side of the goal. Anthony Lopes was helpless.
24' Renan Lodi (Marseille) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
23' Vitinha (Marseille) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
21' Dejan Lovren (Lyon) attempts to discuss the decision with Francois Letexier, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
21' 1 - 0 Goal! Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang passes the ball to the feet of Vitinha (Marseille), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 1:0.
20' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lyon, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
16' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Marseille, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
14' Marseille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
14' Vitinha (Marseille) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
13' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
13' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) is flagged for offside.
12' The resulting corner from Renan Lodi (Marseille) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
11' Michael Murillo (Marseille) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
9' Paul Akouokou (Lyon) commits a rough foul. Francois Letexier stops the game and makes a call.
7' A rebound falls kindly for Jordan Veretout (Marseille), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
6' Henrique (Lyon) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies well wide of the right post.
4' The linesman signals that Michael Murillo (Marseille) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
2' Samuel Gigot (Marseille) wins the ball from the corner and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but it's a soft effort and drifts well past the left post.
1' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Marseille.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Marseille will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Francois Letexier.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
